name: QUIK
description: Building the operating system for business in LATAM

founders.name: Alejandro Flores-Hernandez
founders.bio: Alejandro is a mechanical engineer by education and a system engineer by heart. First working for over 10 years as a Field Service Engineer installing Gas Turbines around the world for General Electric, Rolls-Royce and Siemens. After the pandemic and with the help of a great team, decided to build QUIK. QUIK aims to be the easiest way to buy online in LatAm, becoming the operating system for all kind of business.

founders.name: Mauricio Martínez
founders.bio: I'm a Graphic Designer, Art Director, Marketer and Proyect Manager with 10 years of professional experience.
